m1-pure-fn.title: compute_regime_deficits pure function (TDD)
m1-pure-fn.imperative: Create src/physics/utilization/driver_utility_observable.py with a pure, unit-testable compute_regime_deficits(distance, curvature, v_real, v_ideal, ...) mirroring regime_utilization.regime_utilization's structure (reuse _build_regime_masks from regime_utilization.py, do NOT reinvent) but computing per-regime ABSOLUTE deficit g = mean(v_ideal - v_real) over each mask (never a ratio), plus n_points and sigma_lapsampling = std(deficit[mask])/sqrt(n_points), for axes braking/slow_corner/fast_corner/straight. Write tests/unit/physics/test_driver_utility_observable.py FIRST (red), covering: at-ceiling -> g≈0 all axes; 5%-slower-in-corners-only -> g>0 on braking/slow_corner/fast_corner, g≈0 on straight; sigma_lapsampling closed-form SEM match; masks reused from regime_utilization. Observe it fail, then implement to green.

postconditions.statement: TDD red: test_driver_utility_observable.py written and observed failing (import/attribute error) before compute_regime_deficits exists — manual attest
compute_regime_deficits implemented; unit tests green (at-ceiling g≈0, corner-only-deficit g>0 on corners/braking g≈0 straight, SEM formula pinned)

constraints: no division of v_real by v_ideal anywhere
